spec.name: M6.Normalize.divide_coeff
spec.statement: ∀ (k : ℤ) (p : Polynomial ℤ) (d : ℕ), (M6.Normalize.divide k p).coeff d = p.coeff d / k
queries: polynomial coefficient finite sum integer division
spec.guidance: Expand coefficient of monomial sum, split membership d∈p.support; coeff0 outside support. Exact allintegerk including0. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Normalize.divide_scaled
spec.statement: ∀ (k : ℤ) (p : Polynomial ℤ), k ≠ 0 → M6.Normalize.divide k (Polynomial.C k * p) = p

spec.guidance: Polynomial.ext, divide_coeff, coeff_C_mul; Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left withnonzerok. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Normalize.divide_degree
spec.statement: ∀ (k : ℤ) (p : Polynomial ℤ) (n : ℕ), (∀ d, n < d → p.coeff d = 0) → ∀ d, n < d → (M6.Normalize.divide k p).coeff d = 0
